summary: Legacy fieldset grouping container, hidden from the picker. Use a plain Group (or Form for submit semantics).
description: Field Set renders an HTML fieldset-style container for grouping form controls. It is hidden from the node picker; a plain Group provides the same layout role, with CSS Definition covering fieldset-specific styling if genuinely needed.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use Group instead.
runtimeBehavior: Declared-port-groups: size-mode-dependent layout ports, as on other visual containers.
